prompt: Which correctly moves a game character left when the left arrow key is pressed?
choices: panel.addKeyListener(new KeyAdapter() { public void keyTyped(KeyEvent e) { if (e.getKeyCode() == KeyEvent.VK_LEFT) x -= 5; } });
panel.addKeyListener(new KeyAdapter() { public void keyPressed(KeyEvent e) { if (e.getKeyCode() == KeyEvent.VK_LEFT) { x -= 5; panel.repaint(); } } });
explanation: keyPressed() fires for arrow keys (no Unicode char generated, so keyTyped won't work). Compare getKeyCode() to VK_LEFT. Call repaint() to refresh the display after moving. Option A uses keyTyped, which won't fire for arrow keys. Option C: KeyListener is not a functional interface.
